tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// chos mngon pa'i phung po lnga'i rab tu 'byed pa'i gzhung bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ chos mngon pa'i phung po'i lnga'i rab tu 'byed pa'i don gsal byed ri khrod pa rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba bzhugs so// ji snyed shes bya'i gnas lugs mkhyen cing gzigs// rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal te// gti mug mun sel shes bya'i gnas lugs rnams// gsal bar bya phyir bstan bcos 'di bshad do// rgyal ba'i bstan la tshul bzhin spyod byed cing*// chos rab rgya chen ston par byed pa gang*// chos dang chos nyid rab tu gsal byed pa// zhugs pas rab tu dge bar byed pa yin// rnal 'byor spyod pa la sogs su// rgya cher bshad med mdor bsdu na// dngos kun phung po lngar 'dod do// gzugs dang tshor dang 'du shes dang*// 'du byed rnam shes phung po lnga// phal cher byis pa'i 'gro ba dag /rnam par shes la bdag 'dzin cing*// gzhan dag la ni bdag gir 'dzin// de bas lnga po'i go rim ni// je bas je phrar gnas pa'i phyir// du ma 'dus phyir phung po'o// gzugs ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i phyir// 'byung ba bzhi dang de rgyu byas// rten dang sdud dang smin byed dang*// bskyed par byed las ldan pa nyid// des na rgyu zhes bya bar brjod// bskyed dang rten dang gnas pa dang*// rten dang 'phel bar byed rnams kyis// dbye bas 'bras bur tha snyad byas// sa yi khams ni sra ba nyid// chu yi rlan zhing gsher ba ste// me khams tsha zhing bsreg pa'o// rlung ni yang zhing g.yo ba nyid// rgyur byas pa ni gzugs dang sgra// dri ro reg bya mig sogs kyi// dbang po lnga dang rnam rig byed// rig byed min pa rnams su bzhed// de la mig gi dbang po ni// yul ni kha dog gzugs dngos so// dkar po la sogs kha dog dang*// ring thung phya le ba la sogs// dbyibs yin de don rnam rig byed// mig dbang spyod yul don bcas rnams// rna ba'i dbang po'i yul ni sgra// zin dang ma zin gnyis ka dang*// rnam gsum 'byung ba'i rgyu las byung*// sna dbang yul ni dri nyid de// lhan skyes sbyar dang gyur pa gsum// lce yi dbang po yul ni ro// mngar skyur lan tshwa tsha kha ska// rnam drug gnyis stobs ldan pa yin// lus kyi dbang po'i yul gyur pa// reg bya 'dir ni phyogs cig nyid// 'jam rtsub yang lci grang dro dang*// bkres skom la sogs rnams su 'dod// 'dir ni 'byung ba chen po bzhin// lus kyi dbang po'i yul shes phyir// yid dang de yul chos las ni// 'dir ni phyogs cig bsdus pa ste// rnam rig rnam rig byed min nyid// lus dang ngag gi rnam rig byed// dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan// dbye bas rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// rnam par rig byed ma yin gzugs// 'dod dang gzugs dang gzugs med kyi// dbye bas rnam gsum 'dod par ni// so so thar dang theg chen gyi// sdom dang sdom min der ma gdogs// rnam bzhi'i bsam gtan nyer ldog bcas// lhan cig 'byung ba'i go rims bzhin// rang bzhin zag par bcas dang zag med yin// mdor na chos kyi skye mched lnga// bsdus las gyur dang mngon skabs yod// brda las byung dang kun brtags pa// dbang 'byor rnams su'ang bstan pa yin// de ltar gzugs kyi phung po ni// rgyu gzugs bzhi dang 'bras gzugs ni// rdzas ni bcu gcig bdag nyid de// rnam par phye ba bco lnga'o// mig dbang spyod yul thogs par bcas// gzhan rnams bstan med thogs par bcas// chos kyi skye mched phyogs bstan med// thogs pa med pa'i gzugs rnam gsum// rnam pa gsum du 'dus pa yin// myong ba rnam gsum tshor ba yi// phung po bde sdug btang snyoms so// gang myong 'bral bar mi 'dod cing*// myong bas phrad par mi 'dod la// byung bas gnyis ka spong bar byed// lus sems rten gyi rnam pa gnyis// mig sogs gnas kyi dbye ba yis// drug drug rnams su 'gyur ba yin// yul la mtshan mar 'dzin pa gang*// 'du shes phung por brjod pa'o// de ni gnas dang dmigs pa yi// dbye bas gnyis te tshogs drug gi

/'dus te reg pa las byung ba// rnam shes drug ni gnas rten can// mtshan mar bcas dang mtshan ma med// chung ngu rgya chen tshad med dang*// ci yang med 'di dmigs pas bsdus// sgra yis don la sgro btags kyis// ngo bo dang ni sgra 'di zhes// 'du shes de ni mtshan mar bcas// dngos gang ngo bos sgro ma btags// mya ngan 'das dang srid pa'i rtse// sgro btags med dang tshor mtshan med// gsal ba min phyir mtshan ma med// 'dod dang gzugs dang nam mkha' dang*// rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang*// ci yang med pas rim pa bzhin// chung ngu la sogs pa yis bsdus// de la 'du byed phung po ni// tshor dang 'du shes las gzhan pa'i// sems byung rnams dang de las gzhan// ldan pa ma yin 'du byed rnams// chos gang sems dang mtshungs ldan rnams// kun 'gro lnga dang yul nges lnga// bcu gcig dge ba drug nyon mongs// nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs te// bzhi ni gzhan du yang dag 'jug /reg pa yid la byed pa dang*// tshor dang 'du shes sems dpa' gang*// kun 'gro yin te reg pa ni// dbang yul rnam shes gsum 'dus nas// yongs su gcod pa tshor stan byed// sems kyi 'jug pas dmigs pa la// 'dzin pa'i las can yid la byed// sems dpa'i de ni yon tan dang*// nyes dang lung ma bstan pa la// mngon par 'du byed yid las can// bdun pa bsam ba'i dngos po la// 'dod pa'i brtson 'grus brten byed nyid// mos pa nges pa'i dngos po la// nges 'dzin mi 'phrog las can no// dran pa 'dris pa'i dngos po nyid// mi brjed sems kyi mngon brjod nyid// 'di ni mi g.yeng las can no// ting 'dzin bden sogs rtag dngos la// rtse gcig shes rab rten byed nyid// shes rab kyi ni rab rnam 'byed// rigs tshul rigs min skye dang gzhan// thos bsam sgom pa las byung ba// sems nyid zlog byed yul nges lnga// dad pa las 'bras bden pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum la yid ches shing*// sems dang byed de 'dun rten nyid// ngo tsha shes gang don rig nas// kha na ma tho ba la 'dzem// sdom pa'i rten byed las can no// khrel yod 'jig rten dbang byas te// kha na ma tho 'dzem pa nyid// ma chags pa ni yid 'byung zhing*// chags pa'i gnyen po nyes spyod bzlog

/zhe sdang med pa byams par ldan// shes dang so sor rtogs pa yid// yang dag rtogs 'di gti mug med// rnam gsum nyes pa bzlog rten can// brtson 'grus le lo'i gnyen po ste// dge la mngon par spro ba'o// shin tu sbyangs pas gnas ngan len// sel byed lus sems las rung bas// sgrib pa ma lus sel byed nyid/ bag yod ma chags la sogs la// gnas nas dge sdig blang dor byed// bag med 'joms shing phun tshogs byed// btang snyoms gong bzhin gnas bcas nas// sems mnyam rnal du 'dug pa dang*// lhun gyi grub pas nyon mongs rnams// sel cing mi skye bar byed do// rnam par mi 'tshe snying rje'i phyir// rnam 'tshe'i gnyen po tho mi 'tshams// de ltar dge ba bcu gcig go /nyon mongs 'dod dug las chags ni// nyer len phung po lnga nyid pa// lhag zhen sdug bsngal kun bskyed byed// khong khro sems can mnar byed sems// nyes spyod rten du gyur pa'o// nga rgyal che ba'i nga rgyal dang*// nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal nyid// mngon pa'i nga rgyal cung zad snyam// log pa'i nga rgyal rnam pa bdun// rigs sogs tshul khrims sogs snyem dang*// khyad par du dang phung por snyem// bsam sogs rten snyems cung zad snyem// tshul min bsnyen sogs rim pas yin// khengs pa'o mi gus sdug bsngal bskyed// ma rig 'di ni las 'bras dang*// bden dang skyabs sogs mi shes nyid// de yang lhan gcig skyes pa dang*// kun brtags lta dang mtshungs ldan rnams// log shes the tshom kun bskyed nyid// 'jigs tshogs lta dang phung por lta// bdag lta mchog 'dzin brtul zhugs lta// lnga'o nyer len phung po la// bdag gam bdag gir lta ba can// shes gang gti mug mtshungs ldan nyid// rtag chad lta sogs nyon mongs bcas// rang gi tshul khrims brtul zhugs la// kun nas 'dzin pa sdug bsngal gzhi// gti mug mun pa kun bskyed byed// rtag dang gcig pu rgyu med dang*// mtha' ldan de bzhin lha mi spong*// 'du shes 'du shes med can dang*// chad dang mya ngan 'das pa dang*// rmugs dang kun nas rmongs pa dang*// rten dang reg pa dge slong dag

/rgyu dang don dra ba ste// tha ma tshangs pa'i dra ba'o// drug bcu rtsa gnyis kun 'jigs tshogs// the tshom 'di ni yid gnyis te// dge la mi 'jug byed las can// kun brtags lhan cig skyes 'byung bas// drug 'di nyon mongs rtsa ba'o// khro ba khon 'dzin 'chab pa dang*/ tshig rtsub tshig dang phrag dog dang*// ser sna g.yo sgyu brgyag pa dang*// rnam 'tshe khrel med ngo tsha med// rmugs dang rgod dang mi dad pa// le lo bag med brjed ngas dang*// rnam g.yeng shes bzhin ma yin rnams// nye ba'i nyon mongs nyi shu'o// 'di kun sdug bsngal kun bskyed phyir// drug po rnams dang nye mtshungs so// 'gyod dang gnyid dang rtogs dpyod ni// dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan// kun la 'byung 'gyur rnam pa bzhi// de ltar sems 'byung lnga bcu gcig /ldan pa ma yin 'du byed rnams// gzugs dang sems 'byung gi /skabs so de nyid las gzhan min// de la thob gang gsar rnyed ldan// sa bon dbang dang mngon gyur gyi// dbye bas skad cig la rims 'byung*// 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug ni// bsam gtan gsum pa'i 'dod chags bral// gong ma ma yin 'byung ba yi// 'du shes mngon btang brtan mi g.yo// sems dang sems 'byung 'gog pa'o// de la 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ni// ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi// chags bral srid pa'i rtse mo las// gyen bskyod gnas pa'i 'du shes can// brtan mi rnams dang brtan pa yi// cha shas 'gog pa gang yin pa'o// 'du shes med pa de nyid kyi// snyoms par zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ste// 'bras bu che las gong ma na// grong las dgon pa'i tshul bskyed pa// brtan min sems rnams 'gog pa'o// srog gis dbang po rigs mthun gyis// lhan cig 'du byed gnas rten can// rigs mthun de dang de 'dra nyid// skye ba der ni 'grub byed pa'o// dga' ba zhum zhing 'gyur ba ste// gnas pa de rgyun 'brel pa nyid// mi rtag rgyun de 'dor byed pa'o// ming ni mtshon byed bla dgos// ming dang yi ge 'dus pa'i tshig

/yi ge dbyangs dang gsal byed do// so so 'jig rten 'jig rten pa// 'phags pa'i lam ni ma thob nyid// 'jug pa rgyu 'bras 'brel 'jug pa// so sor nges gang rgyu 'bras gzhan// 'byor gang 'tshams par 'byung ba'o// mgyogs pa rgyu 'bras myur ba'o// go rims rgyu las 'bras 'byung nyid// dus gang de la ltos rnam gsum// yul ni phyogs sogs nyer mjal byed// grangs ni gcig sogs go rims can// tshogs pa 'dus pa zhes bya ste// ldan min 'du byed nyi shu gsum// rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni// dmigs pa rnam par rig byed pa// sems dang yid dang rnam par shes/ kun gzhi der rten nyon mongs can dang*// yid sogs drug dang rnam pa brgyad// sems ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes te// 'du byed sa bon bsags pa can// dmigs rnam yongs su ma chad par// lung ma bstan phyir rigs 'dzin nyid// kun 'gro lnga dang mtshungs ldan pa// rgyun chags 'jug par mdo las bstan// nyon mongs sa bon dag pa gang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po nyid// de phyir dag dang ma dag gnyis// 'gog dang 'du shes med snyoms 'jug /'du shes med pa sa rnams las// langs nas rnam rig byed 'byung ba// 'di yod pas so gzhan gyis min// kha gcig snyoms par zhugs rgyu las// ldang bar byed par 'dod na ko// yid sogs 'gag shing nyer zhig nas// yang srid 'brel pa'i rtog 'byung phyir// mya ngan 'das pa med 'gyur zhing*// rgyu med skye ba nyid du 'gyur// phung po las gzhan rgyur 'dod na// dngos gang drug pa 'byung 'gyur zhing*// lung dang rig pa'i lam la 'gal// de phyir drug po las gzhan nyid// mig sogs dbang po'i shes pa dag /dmigs pa'i rkyen la ltos nas ni// rnam pa gzhan du 'jug pa nyid// yid kyang chos la de ma thag /rang yul lhan cig byed pa can// skad cig 'byung gis gzhan du min// 'du byed rkyen ni rnam pa bzhi// rgyu yi rkyen ni kun gzhi yis/

rnam shes la gnas bag chags te// bdag rkyen dmigs sogs dbang po rnams// de ma thag rkyen 'gag ma thag /dmigs rkyen gzugs la sogs pa'o// de bas 'dus byas skad cig mar// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyis gsungs// de phyir sa bon thams cad pa// sred pa'i nying mtshams sbyor byed pos// len pa zhes byar gsungs pa nyid// 'dir 'brel yid ni nyon mongs can// kun gzhi la dmigs bdag tu rmongs// bdag lta nga rgyal chags pa sogs// mtshungs ldan rigs bzhi rgyun chags 'jug /'phags sogs rnams la rgyun mi 'jug /de bas nyon mongs can du brjod// dag pa'i yid ni 'jug pa nyid// de bas gcig dang gsum dang drug /dgur yang rtogs pas byas pa ste// 'dir ni brgyad du bstan pa yin// de ltar phung po lnga po ni// dngos rnams ma lus bsdus pa'o// de la skye mched bcu gnyis ni// mig sogs lnga dang gzugs sogs lnga// gzugs kyi phung por bstan pa bzhin// yid ni rnam shes phung po'o// de yul chos kyi skye mched ni// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas rnam gnyis// tshor dang 'du shes 'du byed dang*// rnam par rig byed ma yin gang*// 'dus byas rnams so sngon du bshad// 'dus ma byas ni rnam pa bzhi// nam mkha' gzugs kyi go 'byed nyid// so sor brtags min 'gog pa ni// dngos gang 'gog pa bral ba'o// de ni nyon mongs la sogs kyi// gnyen po med kyang mi skyed nyid// so sor brtag pa'i 'gog pa ni// 'gog pa de ni bral ba ste// gnyen pos bcom pas mi skye nyid// de bzhin nyid ni chos rnams kyis// chos nyid chos rnams med pa'o// de ni skye sogs mi dmigs phyir// 'dus ma byas te bsam mi khyab// der ltar chos gyi skye mched brgyad// rnam shes skye sgo byed pa'i phyir// skye mched ces ni bstan pa yin// dbang po yul dang rnam shes rnam// khams kyi tshogs kyang yin par bstan// rnam shes khams ni drug po rnams// 'gag ma thag pa yid kyi khams// rnam par shes pa'i gnas brtan phyir// bstan to sems kyi khams bdun yin// byed po med la rang nyid kyi// mtshan nyid 'dzin phyir khams zhes brjod// 'di dag thams cad mkhyen pa yis// gcig pu za dang byed pa por// 'dzin po'i gnyen por rgya cher gsungs// rgyu mthun rnam par smin pa dang*// dri med skyes bu'i byed 'bras rnams// chos 'di rnams la zhugs gyur pas// kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub kyis// dbye bas 'khrul dang yang dag rtogs// de bzhin nyid ces tha snyad byas// de phyir blo ldan theg pa mchog la zhugs pa rnams// zab cing rgya chen mthon po'i gnas la mngon brten nas// 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das snang ba rab bskyed de// thams cad mkhyen nyid bla med 'bras bu bsgrub par bya// nyes pa'i tshogs kun 'phags pa rnams la bzod par gsol// dge bas 'gro rnams thams cad mkhyen pa thob par shog
/dam pa'i chos mngon pa'i don rnam par bsdu ba/ rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba rdzogs so/// /
